description: Zoie CRM brings your customer data into the conversation. Look up leads and contacts, check their status and recent activity, and create or update records without leaving the chat. Review conversations, calls, and campaign details, and act on your pipeline directly — so you can answer "where does this deal stand?" and update it in one place.
